components.name: High-Performance Quantized Memory Engine
components.purpose: Provides a 1.58-bit ternary graph embedding layer, sparse matrix-vector multiplication spreading activation recall, Hebbian learning, and Ebbinghaus memory fading consolidation.
database_dependencies: None (directly serializes to local binary file solomon_brain_map.bin)
test_paths: tests/test_quantized_memory.py (Note: test_quantized_memory.py is missing from this branch's test suite, but memory functions are imported and validated indirectly via app.py and tests/test_gabriel.py)
components.security_concerns: Direct file writes to solomon_brain_map.bin without file path bounds verification inside serialize/deserialize routines.

components.name: Mnemosyne Knowledge Cards Module
components.purpose: A governed repository structure for managing episodic, factual, procedural, and warning memory cards, complete with status workflows, clearance scopes, and relationship graphing.
test_paths: tests/core/solomon_knowledge_cards/test_mnemosyne.py (Note: core tests are absent on this branch's test/ directory)
components.security_concerns: Schema validation allows arbitrary tag insertions without strict alphanumeric escaping.

components.name: SQLite Database Manager
components.purpose: Provides atomic card storage, SQLite connection factory with WAL mode, busy timeout, and automatic schema migrations.
database_dependencies: solomon_soss.db (or whatever db_path is supplied during initialization)

components.name: Solomon Loki Futures Engine
components.purpose: Calculates pre-qualification (Gate A) and post-simulation confirmation (Gate B) boundaries for futures projections.
components.security_concerns: Direct file-based checkpoint locks can suffer from race conditions.

components.name: Daily Scan Orchestration Script
components.purpose: Triggers daily scanning operations across sports, news, and market adapters, publishing daily codex projections.
components.security_concerns: Uses direct evaluation/formatting of subprocess execution context without sandboxing.

components.name: Governance Approval Packet
components.purpose: Provides promotion approval controls and logs transactions to a binary log for security audits.
components.security_concerns: governance_log.bin write boundaries rely on simple raw struct packs which could overwrite prior events if offset pointers drift.

components.name: Quantized Engine Budget & Efficiency Guard
components.purpose: Intended to manage execution budget arrays and enforce T1-T5 tiers via memory-mapped budget tables.
duplicate_implementations: We have core/solomon_context_budgeter.py instead, which implements basic token limits but not the claimed T1-T5 memory budget tables.

components.name: Gabriel Capability Assimilation Engine
components.purpose: A laboratory pipeline for dynamic task lease acquisitions, AST inspections, and dynamic loading experiments.
components.security_concerns: Dynamic imports of unapproved Python modules via dynamic_loader.py are vulnerable to directory traversal and remote code execution if capability directories are compromised.

components.name: Resident Daemon Framework
components.purpose: Intended to provide the zero-copy memory-mapped checkpoint mechanism for background loops.

components.name: Guardian Resident Daemon
components.purpose: Intended to manage background telemetry, disk usage, and host checks in a continuous loop.

components.name: Jules Resident Daemon
components.purpose: Intended to perform automated repository scans, duplicate checks, and validation proposals.

components.name: MD8 Testing & Verification Framework
components.purpose: Intended to provide O(1) slot hashing linear-probing index checks over a zero-copy memory substrate with fcntl locks.

components.name: God Eye Bridge API
components.purpose: Intended to map 128-byte ternary memory embeddings into 3D semantic layout coordinates.

components.name: God Eye Real-Time Dashboard UI
components.purpose: Frontend layout rendering a 3D semantic force-directed network graph at 60 FPS using Three.js with pre-allocated buffer geometries.
configuration_dependencies: Uses hardcoded /api/memory/graph.json route (not present on any backend Flask mapping)
components.security_concerns: Loads Three.js from external CDNs, creating potential XSS/CSP issues if unpinned.

components.name: Futures Dashboard Backend API
components.purpose: Serves projection outputs, receives executions, and binds presentation-level event metadata to candidate hashes.
components.security_concerns: Allows direct submission of execute tasks without verifying signatures.

components.name: Futures Prediction Dashboard UI
components.purpose: Displays prediction items with biological coloring thresholds (blue for 90, red for 80) and secure Governance refusal status handling.

components.name: Resident Daemon Dashboard API
components.purpose: Intended to serve /api/residents/status and /api/residents/messages REST endpoints.

components.name: Global Health & Telemetry Dashboard
components.purpose: Intended to serve global health metrics and telemetry analysis endpoints.

components.name: Hyper Registry Manager
components.purpose: Intended to enforce O(1) semantic metadata constraints, DFS dependency cycles, and alphabetic loader rules.

components.name: Learning Writeback Service
components.purpose: Updates memory nodes on successful execution or corrections and provides a REST writeback gate.
components.security_concerns: Allows memory updates without strong signature validations or actor provenance checks.

components.name: Solomon Core Gateway Application
components.purpose: Starts the central WSGI HTTP service, configures Flask blueprint routes, loads initial in-memory quantized maps, and initializes global lifecycles.
components.security_concerns: Global Flask error handler outputs tracebacks if in debug mode, potentially exposing sensitive database structure information.
